prerequisites_en: Medical history and physical examination; further examinations to be decided by the clinical team when necessary.
layer5_actions.problem_en: Gastrointestinal bleeding and intestinal obstruction are issues documented in prior and current hospitalization.

layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: Reassess nutrition, glucose, urine ketones, and hydration status and manage according to findings
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: During the current hospitalization and before discharge
layer5_actions.indication_en: Confirm whether metabolic and nutritional status is suitable for discharge or continued treatment
prerequisites_en: Current symptoms, food intake status, and relevant repeat examination results.
layer5_actions.problem_en: Records of nutritional risk, hypoglycemia, positive urinary ketones, and elevated urine specific gravity
layer5_actions.target_and_laterality_en: Systemic and metabolic status; no laterality.

layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: Have oncology confirm the subsequent chemotherapy plan, eligibility conditions, and follow-up schedule
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: Before discharge or transition to follow-up; before the next-cycle treatment decision.
layer5_actions.indication_en: Clarify treatment continuity and the post-discharge monitoring plan.
prerequisites_en: Complete reassessment of hematologic, gastrointestinal, nutritional, and metabolic status
layer5_actions.problem_en: Recent intravenous chemotherapy has been documented, but the next-step regimen and continuity-of-care arrangements have not been disclosed

layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: After reassessment and confirmation of stability, document formal discharge, referral, or continuity-of-care handoff
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: Before the end of the current hospitalization
layer5_actions.indication_en: Confirm that safe disposition and responsibility for subsequent care have been implemented
prerequisites_en: Symptoms and complications are stable; discharge conditions are clear; treatment and follow-up plans have been documented.
layer5_actions.problem_en: The current disclosed status is active hospitalization, with only a pre-discharge improvement record

acceptable_aliases_en: do not infer progression from markers alone
layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: Do not diagnose tumor progression or infection solely from abnormal tumor markers or inflammatory-related laboratory values
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: In current diagnostic and treatment decision-making
layer5_actions.indication_en: Avoid overinterpreting limited laboratory summaries and changing treatment on that basis.
prerequisites_en: In conjunction with symptoms, signs, and necessary clinical assessment
layer5_actions.problem_en: Abnormal tumor markers and inflammation-related indicators, but lacking corresponding clinical or imaging evidence

active_problems.canonical_en: Currently receiving or recently received intravenous chemotherapy.
Gastrointestinal bleeding is recorded; its current severity is unclear
Intestinal obstruction is recorded; whether it is currently relieved is unclear
Nutritional risk
Recent lymphocytopenia.
Hypoglycemia and positive urinary ketones.

blockers.canonical_en: Current vital signs, symptom assessment, and the clinical severity of intestinal obstruction and gastrointestinal bleeding are lacking.
Current complete blood count is lacking, especially white blood cell differential and neutrophil results
Actual discharge, discharge conditions, and continuity follow-up arrangements have not yet been confirmed by current evidence

critical_facts_to_retain.canonical_en: Background of malignant gastric tumor and maintenance chemotherapy.
Documentation of gastrointestinal bleeding, intestinal obstruction, and nutritional risk
Recent intravenous chemotherapy record.
Recent lymphopenia, hypoglycemia, and positive urine ketones.
The pre-discharge record is improved, but it cannot be treated as current completed discharge

diagnoses.canonical_en: Malignant gastric neoplasm, recorded as an admission diagnosis related to maintenance chemotherapy

facts_to_retract_or_correct.canonical_en: The clinical time in a pre-discharge record cannot be regarded as an actual discharge that has already occurred.
Tumor progression or infection cannot be inferred solely from tumor-marker or inflammation-related abnormalities
The specific degree of leukopenia or neutropenia cannot be diagnosed based on the summary

management_state.canonical_en: The inpatient oncology treatment record states improvement, but the patient is currently in active inpatient status; safety reassessment, problem management, and confirmation of a discharge or subsequent treatment plan need to be completed.

required_delta_from_previous_checkpoint.canonical_en: A pre-discharge outcome of improved was newly available for the recent hospitalization; the current public state still shows an active encounter, so discharge and continuity of care are not confirmed.

Previously documented malignant gastric neoplasm, maintenance chemotherapy, gastrointestinal problems, nutritional risk, and laboratory abnormalities remain relevant; no evidence supports retracting them.

treatment_readiness.canonical_en: Recent intravenous chemotherapy has been recorded, but current evidence is insufficient to confirm hematologic, metabolic, and gastrointestinal safety conditions for the next chemotherapy cycle.

hard_failure_rules_en: Do not treat a pre-discharge record whose clinical time is later than the current public time point as an actual discharge that has already occurred.
It must not be confirmed that chemotherapy can be safely continued or that discharge is safe before reassessing hematology, gastrointestinal complications, and metabolic status.
critical_omission_rules_en: Failure to document gastrointestinal bleeding, intestinal obstruction, leukopenia, hypoglycemia, and nutritional risk may affect treatment and disposition safety.
Tumor progression or infection must not be diagnosed solely on the basis of abnormal tumor markers or inflammation-related indices.

stopping.rationale_en: Although the recent hospitalization has a pre-discharge outcome recorded as improved, the encounter remains active and safety and disposition are not fully confirmed. Investigation should not stop, and discharge or follow-up should not be declared safe until clinical reassessment and oncology planning are completed.
remaining_blockers_en: The activity and severity of current gastrointestinal bleeding and intestinal obstruction are unclear.
Current complete blood count differential and neutrophil results are lacking.
Whether hypoglycemia, positive urine ketones, and nutritional status have been corrected is unclear
Formal discharge conditions, the subsequent chemotherapy plan, and continuity-follow-up handoff have not been confirmed.

question.question_en: At this time point, use only available evidence to identify key evidence, supported claims, patient state, appropriate next actions, and whether stopping or follow-up is safe.

completion_criteria_en: Malignant gastric tumor as the main treatment-related diagnosis has been specified by inpatient records
The current status assessment has been completed for accompanying issues affecting treatment, including gastrointestinal bleeding, intestinal obstruction, and nutritional risk.
partial_criteria_en: A malignant gastric tumor has been documented, but the current severity of accompanying gastrointestinal problems has not been clarified.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If the current diagnosis record is subsequently found inconsistent with clinical assessment, the main diagnosis and treatment indication should be re-verified.

completion_criteria_en: Complete assessment of current hematologic, gastrointestinal, nutritional, and metabolic status
Oncology confirms the applicable conditions and monitoring plan for continuing chemotherapy or other treatment
partial_criteria_en: Recent intravenous chemotherapy has been received, but current hematologic and complication safety conditions have not yet been completely confirmed
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If uncontrolled bleeding, obstruction, significant hematologic suppression, or metabolic instability is present, it should not be considered that safe treatment conditions have been met
If maintenance chemotherapy is mistakenly regarded as completion of all definitive treatment, antitumor treatment goals and the treatment plan should be rechecked

completion_criteria_en: Complete a clinical assessment of tolerance and efficacy of recent treatment.
Clarify the subsequent treatment, monitoring, and symptom-management plan
partial_criteria_en: The inpatient record shows treatment outcome improvement, but specific efficacy indicators and a complete subsequent management plan are lacking.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: A general improvement record cannot be equated with complete remission or treatment completion.

completion_criteria_en: Confirm that conditions for discharge or transfer are met
Formally document arrangements for subsequent chemotherapy, follow-up visits, monitoring, and handover to the responsible team
partial_criteria_en: There is a record of an anticipated discharge outcome of improvement, but current active hospitalization and formal transition of continuous care have not yet been confirmed.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: Safe discharge or follow-up handoff should not be completed when bleeding, obstruction, metabolic, or hematologic risks have not been assessed or stabilized.
